sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; China demand pivot and Trump regime-change dynamics weigh on pricing. WA exploration remains active with multiple new discoveries.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face earnings downgrades. Small-cap explorers (Critica, Forrestania, PLC Resources, Sarytogan) offer speculative upside but remain high-risk.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts still maturing. Housing weakness and no auction bounce pressure NIM and credit growth. RBA policy uncertainty with Fed in focus.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin compression. Defensive dividend yields attractive but growth limited. Monitor RBA response to oil-driven inflation.

sectors.trend: Oil spike and fuel excise pressure signal policy intervention. Australia nears energy inflection point — renewables and gas transition accelerating.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, AGL.AX, CGP.AX, SSO.AX benefit from policy tailwinds. QAN.AX, BUD.AX face input cost pressure. LNG exporters (WDS.AX) supported by global oil strength.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator in financial collapse and division; sector consolidation underway. CSL.AX remains stable but global demand softness noted.
sectors.implications: Private hospital operators (IAG-linked, HIC) face restructuring risk. CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) relatively insulated but watch global demand signals.

sectors.trend: Housing auction market flat, prices falling. Caravan manufacturer shuts. Fuel costs squeeze consumer discretionary. Gen X retirement anxiety rising.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. WES.AX, WOW.AX, LSG.AX under margin pressure from fuel and input costs.

sectors.trend: Anthropic AI slowdown call triggers global tech sell-off; Trump counters. ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) caught in crossfire.
sectors.implications: Short-term volatility in ASX tech. Cloud/AI infrastructure names face re-rating. Long-term AI capex cycle intact but near-term sentiment negative.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Iron ore crash and oil-driven inflation create a stagflationary tilt. Fed meeting and RBA response are key. 10-yr yield at 5% caps equity multiples. Expect volatility in materials and energy; financials and healthcare provide relative stability.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and energy transition policy delivers. Housing correction may create value in bank equities. WA mining pipeline and critical minerals offer structural upside. Immigration policy shift is a wildcard for productivity and construction. AI capex cycle remains intact post-volatility.
